en: PDF title. Always set in the metadata, and drawn as a heading at the top of the body unless drawTitle is false.

Whether to draw title as a heading at the top of the body. Default true. Pass false when the body already starts with its own heading (e.g. a Markdown "# ..." line): the title then goes into the metadata only (Info /Title, and XMP dc:title when tagged), so tagged output keeps the dc:title PDF/UA-1 (ISO 14289-1, 7.1) requires without a duplicated H1.
